description: First-run device access checklist shared by the Android host (apps/android) and the shared web UI (apps/web). Android reports these item ids in this order (notifications only on API 33+); the web UI owns the copy for each id. Every item must be backed by code that uses the permission.

notAsked.android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC: Normal permission granted at install; used by the device unlock prompt.
notAsked.android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE: No Grogoni code reads it; the default SMS role grants it, so sending and reading do not depend on it here.
notAsked.android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE: Normal permission granted at install; required to host the WhatsApp sidecar foreground service that keeps linked messaging alive.
notAsked.android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_RE: Normal permission granted at install; declares the WhatsApp sidecar foreground service type as remote messaging on Android 14+.
notAsked.android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE: Normal permission granted at install; lets the WhatsApp sidecar restart its foreground service after a reboot so linked messaging resumes.
notAsked.android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO: Not on the checklist: asked by Android at the first tap on a microphone (voice typing, voice notes, talking with agents), and only the app's own pages receive audio (PermissionChecklistPolicy.audioCaptureDecision).
